SEC_FILING_DATE.definition: Official SEC filing date assigned by EDGAR upon receipt and filing processing (format: YYYY-MM-DD).
SEC_FILING_DATE.use: Determines statutory point-in-time snapshot eligibility against MANIFEST_SNAPSHOT_BOUNDARY.

SEC_ACCEPTANCE_TIMESTAMP.definition: Exact UTC timestamp when EDGAR accepted the electronic transmission (format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.000Z or YYYYMMDDhhmmss).
SEC_ACCEPTANCE_TIMESTAMP.use: Provides intra-day precision and temporal ordering for same-day filings.

SOURCE_DOWNLOAD_TIMESTAMP.definition: UTC timestamp when the raw filing bytes were fetched via HTTP from sec.gov into local cache.
SOURCE_DOWNLOAD_TIMESTAMP.use: Network retrieval auditing and cache provenance; never used for regulatory eligibility.

CACHE_WRITE_TIMESTAMP.definition: Local file system creation/modification timestamp on disk.
CACHE_WRITE_TIMESTAMP.use: Diagnostic cache freshness check; never used for regulatory eligibility.

raw_source_bytes_authority.name: RAW_SOURCE_SHA256
raw_source_bytes_authority.definition: Cryptographic SHA256 computed directly over the exact raw byte sequence retrieved from SEC EDGAR.
invariants: Raw source bytes must remain permanently immutable.
A normalized hash mismatch must never imply raw-source corruption.

normalized_text_representation.name: NORMALIZED_TEXT_SHA256
normalized_text_representation.definition: Cryptographic SHA256 computed over the canonically decoded, entity-decoded, and whitespace-normalized text.
normalization_pipeline: 1. Decode raw bytes to Unicode string (UTF-8, with Windows-1252 / ISO-8859-1 fallback).
2. Normalize line breaks: replace CRLF (\r\n) and CR (\r) with Unix LF (\n).
3. Decode HTML entities:   and   -> space; & -> &; < -> <; > -> >; " -> "; — -> em-dash; – -> en-dash.
4. Structural text extraction: extract text preserving single newlines between block elements (p, div, tr, br, h1-h6).
5. Whitespace normalization: collapse contiguous inline whitespace ([ \t]+) to single space; strip line-trailing whitespace.

pffd_timestamp_reconciliation.root_cause_explanation: Differing reported dates correspond to distinct ontological concepts: 2026-03-31 is the authoritative SEC filing date; 2026-03-01 is the internal prospectus effective date printed on the document face; 2026-09-27 is the local HTTP download timestamp. All dates are strictly pre-boundary (<= 2026-09-24T23:59:59Z).
